# Pilot launch note

Public sample for the CoSens first-memory walkthrough. The project and decisions below are a sample, not a company announcement.

## Decision

The pilot targets October 26, 2026. Start with five invited teams.

## Open dependency

The security review still needs approval before launch. The target date is conditional on that approval.

## Next action

Check the security review status before confirming the launch date. If approval is still pending, report the blocker rather than promise the date.
